title: Signa Covenant: the Privy policy on the facility admin wallet
broadcast: none: every probe is signed at most, never sent, and unmineable

policy.name: Signa admin: createWaiver on the vault only
policy.doesNotCap: duration: Privy's calldata comparator never matches integers narrower than uint64, and duration is uint32

controls.name: revokeWaiver on the facility vault
controls.privyResponse: {"error":"RPC request denied due to policy violation","code":"policy_violation"}

controls.name: createWaiver on the FacilityRegistry
controls.privyResponse: {"error":"RPC request denied due to policy violation","code":"policy_violation"}

controls.name: createWaiver on the vault, chain 1
controls.privyResponse: {"error":"RPC request denied due to policy violation","code":"policy_violation"}

controls.name: createWaiver above maxWaiverDuration
controls.varies: duration: the policy cannot cap uint32, so the contract and pre-validation do

governance.name: Change the wallet's policies with one approver's signature
governance.detail: PATCH the wallet with its current policy_ids, signed by the risk officer alone: a no-op if accepted
governance.privyResponse: {"error":"Number of signatures in `privy-authorization-signature` header does not match the wallet's authorization threshold.","code":"invalid_data"}

governance.name: Change the policy with the app secret alone
governance.detail: PATCH the policy with its current name and no signature: a no-op if accepted
governance.privyResponse: {"error":"Missing `privy-authorization-signature` header or no signatures provided. Learn more about authorization signatures here: https://docs.privy.io/api-reference/authorization-signatures","code":"invalid_data"}
